record.question: Consider the following statements regarding the Mizoram Universal HealthCare Scheme (MUHCS): (i) For Contributory Beneficiaries under the Standard Plan, a Premium of Rs. 5000 per family per year allows family to get benefit of 8,00,000/- per family per year in Semi-Private (shared) Ward. (ii) No contribution from AB PM-JAY beneficiaries is required. (iii) Provisional Employees under the Government of Mizoram will have to pay monthly contribution of Rs. 100 for General Ward. Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
